liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Space** (2 other sources): Space contains a tease of The Other One before Truckin'; Space includes a tease of The Other One leading into Truckin' [1][2]
- **The Music Never Stopped** (1 review): Reviewer found the opening Music Never Stopped perfunctory and by-the-book [20]

## Setlist highlights

- **gd88-10-15 s1t01 Tuning**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [25]
- **gd88-10-15 s1t02 The Music Never Stopped**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [25]
- **gd88-10-15 s1t03 Sugaree**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [25]
- **gd88-10-15 s1t04 Blow Away**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [25]
- **gd88-10-15 s1t05 Walkin' Blues**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [25]
- **gd88-10-15 s1t06 When Push Comes To Shove**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [25]
- **gd88-10-15 s1t07 Queen Jane Approximately**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [25]
- **gd88-10-15 s1t08 Tennessee Jed**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [25]

## The recordings

- **gd1988-10-15.142462.sbd-aud.composite.eaton.miller.clugston.flac1648** (recommended): matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 22 songs; 144 min [1]
- **gd1988-10-15.141447.fob.schoeps.cmc3.mk41.pcm.mattes.miller.clugston.flac1644**: audience recording; 22 songs; 147 min; rated 2/5 by 1 [2]
- **gd1988-10-15.152002.ultramatrix.miller.flac2496**: soundboard; 20 songs; 150 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [3]. Said about its sound: Master had severe flutter needing dozens of hours of repair using pitch-correction settings; a flutter sample is included [3]
- **gd88-10-15.aud.leeds.17181.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 19 songs; 143 min; rated 2.25/5 by 7 [5]. Said about its sound: Audience recording sounds muddy and distant; Phil's bass notes dissolve into distortion, though the reviewer has heard worse; Reviewer found the audience source's sound lacking and hopes for a better source; Reviewer says the audience recording sounds rather good, though the video they mention is actually from the next night, the 16th [14][15][19][20][23]
- **gd88-10-15.set2.partial.miller.28438.sbeok.flacf**: soundboard; 6 songs; 37 min; rated 2.64/5 by 11 [12]. Said about its sound: Partial second-set soundboard sounds like a matrix: clean, well mixed; good recordings of this show were scarce for years [16]

## Around the show

- The Bayfront Center was an outdated venue about to be torn down [14]
- Reviewer attended both nights; Saturday was hot, with MIDI sounds creeping into the playing [15]
- One of only four shows near the reviewer's hometown during 1984-95; the venue has since been torn down [16]
- Fans took over vacant downtown lots; police were friendly, and some visited the Dali museum before Saturday's show [23]
- Nobody was apparently on hand to flip the tape during the first set [3]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1988-10-15.142462.sbd-aud.composite.eaton.miller.clugston.flac1648**: taped by Rob Eaton; transferred by Scott Clugston and Charlie Miller; source: flac16/48kHz ; Source Info: 1st Set - Master UltraMatrix Soundboard Dat > Technics Reel to Reel > Panasonic SV-3800 Dat (16/48k); 2nd Set - Audience recording… [1]
- **gd1988-10-15.141447.fob.schoeps.cmc3.mk41.pcm.mattes.miller.clugston.flac1644**: taped by Ted Mattes; transferred by Scott Clugston and Charlie Miller; source: Source Info: Ted Mattes' Master (FOB) Audience PCM; Scoeps CMC3/MK41 > Oade P/S > Sony PCM-F1 > Sony SL-2000; Tansfer Info: PCM (Sony SL-10)> Sony PCM-601ESD >… [2]
- **gd1988-10-15.152002.ultramatrix.miller.flac2496**: taped by Don Pearson and Dan Healy; transferred by All Transfers and Mastering by Charlie Miller  March 2, 2021; source: UltraMatrix SBD > Cassette Master (TDK MA-XG) [3]. Also: Ultramatrix recorded by Don Pearson and Dan Healy; patches came from Eaton, Latvala, Mattes and Clugston sources [3]
- **gd88-10-15.aud.leeds.17181.sbeok.shnf**: source: UNKNOWN AUD>?>?>SHN Conversion: MKW>WAVE LAB>CD WAVE>MKW>SHN (Seekable) by Steven Leeds [5]
- **gd88-10-15.set2.partial.miller.28438.sbeok.flacf**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: flac16 Set 2 partial: SBD -> Dat Master (48k) -> Dat (Cloned From Vault Master) [12]

## Art and photos

- Fan art by LiveGRATEFUL.net: [Grateful Dead 1988-10-15 Sat Bayfront Center Arena, St. Petersburg, FL](https://www.livegrateful.net/post/1416200337380/grateful-dead-1988-10-15-sat-bayfront) [26]
